text:
Alicia M.: Quick async check-in for key sweep / IAM/KMS.
What I did: ran nightly key-scan across prod accounts, flagged 3 service-account keys >90 days. Rotated 2 (svc-billing, svc-telemetry). Left svc-legacy-key alone because it's hardwired into legacy-deploy pipeline. PR created to update creds + rotation steps: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3145
Blockers: need prod-deploy owner to approve a short downtime window or coordinate a rolling deploy. The legacy deploy uses an inline creds file in infra/legacy/deploy.sh.
Today: scheduling a 30m maintenance window with SRE, will verify post-rotation smoke tests and update runbook. @Kevin L. can you review PR when you have a sec? :pray:

Kevin L.: On it. I'll review PR today. Can you paste the grep you used to find the hardwired key? helps me confirm scope. Also agree with canary rollout first.

Alicia M.: Sure — command I used:
```
grep -R "AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}" infra/ | grep legacy || true
```
Found matches in infra/legacy/deploy.sh and infra/legacy/ci/credentials.env. I redacted keys in the PR.

Jia W.: FYI that svc-legacy-key is in AWS acct 123456789012 and is a KMS CMK with cross-account usage. Rotating requires updating the key policy + re-encrypting a small set of secrets. I'll open a short runbook and a cloud-support case if we need a KMS import.
Checklist I'm starting: [open case], [update key policy], [re-encrypt secrets], [deploy canary].
CLI to list CMKs I used:
```
aws kms list-keys --profile prod --region us-west-2
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/svc-legacy-key
```

Sam (SRE): Heads up — avoid full restart at midnight. Suggest canary 5% for 2 hours then 25% for 1 hour. If smoke tests fail, automatic rollback. I've attached our minimal canary playbook: https://confluence.internal/playbooks/canary-rotations
We should also set alert: token-errors > 5% in 10m => rollback.

Priya G.: Compliance note: any CMK policy changes need changelog entry + owning team sign-off for audit. Please add an entry to the security-changes channel and tag me. Also need to record reason in the rotation ticket (PCI reqs).

engsec-bot: Automated vuln-scan summary for infra/legacy: 1 medium (outdated boto3 in ci image), 0 high. Ticket created: SEC-4782. Recommend bumping image and re-running scan post-rotation.

Kevin L.: Reviewed PR comments and left 2 small nits about logging and retry logic. No objections to rotation plan. @Alicia M. — once you slot the canary window, I can approve the PR and pair on the deploy.

Alicia M.: Thanks all — scheduling canary for tomorrow 09:30 PST (5%/2h then 25%/1h). I'll add the changelog entry and tag @Priya G. in the ticket. Will also address the boto3 image bump (SEC-4782) before the deploy. :thumbsup:
